reason: The hypothesis combines the kinetic control of phase selection from non-Mg HEAs (P8, P9, P13, P14, P19, P22) with the specific intermetallic-oxide passivation mechanism observed in Mg-Ti-Zn alloys (P4, P5, P6, P7) to propose a dual-effect pathway for a Mg-containing lightweight HEA. It links thermal aging to intermetallic formation and then to a coherent oxide layer, a causal chain not stated in any single passage. The proposal to use controlled annealing to engineer both intermetallic distribution and oxide passivation in a metastable Mg-containing HEA goes beyond the individual findings.
